title: Curriculum and Instruction in Secondary School Social Sciences
description: Explores the area of Social Studies as a multidisciplinary subject that draws from the social sciences and humanities to study human interaction with natural and social environments. While there is a theoretical component to the course, the learning of best practices in social studies education dominates.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EDCI 773, ED-E 757.
May be offered in English or French.
